operating_rules: CURRENT contains at most one actively implemented product train and may be empty between merged trains.
NEXT is ordered and contains concrete player-facing trains, not cleanup placeholders.
Canonical Zork solutions remain valid even when new physically valid workarounds are added.
A reusable object or learned workaround remains useful wherever the same physical logic reasonably applies.
Cleverness should reduce repeated friction rather than create a new fetch-grind tax.
Soft sequence breaks are allowed only when physically earned, state-safe, and non-bricking.
No universal crafting grid, arbitrary object-pair matrix, generic physics simulator, recursive audit machinery, TODO-only slice, or no-op scaffolding.
DONE requires merged or otherwise immutable proof.

current.title: Dam Survival & Prepared Rescue
current.outcome: Make Flood Control Dam #3 a deterministic physical hazard whose real gate/water state, carried weight, maintenance ladder, and existing rope authority change the consequences of deliberate risky actions.
current.showcase: An overloaded overflow descent can lose recoverable gear; open sluices can make the same unprepared descent lethal; tying the real rope to the physical maintenance ladder creates a fixed handline that catches the slip and can also rescue a deliberate river-entry experiment.
acceptance: canonical GATES-OPEN and LOW-TIDE remain the only dam water-state authority
a physical maintenance ladder is targetable at the dam top and Dam Base while normal authored exits remain safe
closed high-water overflow plus an overloaded unprepared descent can drop the heaviest eligible loose item to Dam Base for recovery
open sluices plus an overloaded unprepared descent can kill the adventurer
the existing rope can be tied to the maintenance ladder through the existing material-rope anchor authority
the prepared fixed handline changes the dangerous ladder slip into a survivable descent
open-sluice river entry without preparation is lethal while the fixed handline enables recovery to shore
the canonical inflatable/magic boat and RBOAT-FUNCTION remain the normal river-travel solution
production artifact is locked and reproducible
boundaries: no duplicate rope or inventory authority
normal authored dam movement remains valid

next.title: Troll Disarm & Stolen Weapons
next.outcome: Let the canonical troll seize or retain real weapons under authored combat conditions, creating recoverable consequences, bargaining, taunts, and the possibility of facing your own lost weapon.

next.title: Thief Retaliation & Sabotage
next.outcome: Give the thief authored retaliation, selective theft, sabotage, warnings, and earned hostility based on visible treatment and real object history.
boundaries: preserve canonical roaming and treasure behavior

next.title: Grue Ecology & Colony Reveal
next.outcome: Turn selected darkness experiments into discoverable grue ecology, including lure behavior, stronger-light experiments, a colony reveal, and authored survival or catastrophic outcomes.
boundaries: not every dark room becomes a hive

next.title: Fire, Smoke & Structural Consequences
next.outcome: Extend material physicality into a small set of authored fire, smoke, collapse, and machinery consequences with fair warnings, escape routes, and persistent world state.
boundaries: no generalized chemistry or gas simulator

next.title: Mara Reciprocal Rescue & Shared Danger
next.outcome: Advance Mara through shared physical danger, reciprocal rescue, injuries/recovery, promises, temporary custody, separation/reunion, and remembered choices rather than an approval economy.

future.title: Forest That Answers Back / Described World = Interactive World
future.outcome: Turn selected concrete nouns already present in authored forest descriptions into targetable, stateful world objects whose interactions compose with existing physicality instead of remaining decorative prose.
boundaries: promote authored nouns selectively where interaction creates real play

future.title: Time, Weather & Disaster Arc
future.outcome: Layer authored time and weather conditions plus selected disasters onto real geography and material state to create preparation, shelter, traversal, rescue, and aftermath play.
boundaries: reuse existing geography and object state
conditions must create visible player choices and consequences

future.title: Causal Death & Warning Depth
future.outcome: Broaden fair cause-warning-consequence chains, near-death records, delayed consequences, and exact-object provenance without turning death into a generic simulation framework.

future.title: Museum & Ecology Second Expansion
future.outcome: Continue physical specimen, provenance, collection, and ecology stories only where they create new field play rather than checklist accumulation.

future.title: Narrative Perspective Experiments
future.outcome: Build isolated first-person, third-person, and interactive-storybook editions against real canonical state without changing normal Zork.

future.title: DRAW + Multi-Agent Experiments
future.outcome: Explore DRAW and multi-agent interactive-fiction experiments only after the playable product supports them, keeping experiments isolated from the canonical release train until deliberately promoted.

parked.title: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Glulx Game
